reinforcement learning methods can be used to solve the optimal control problem for nonlinear dynamical systems.

reinforcement learning can be used to design feedback controllers that are optimal in the sense that they minimize a user-prescribed performance function and that the resulting controllers are adaptive in the sense that the controller parameters adapt to the system dynamics in real time using only data measured along the system trajectories.
